Name: Easy Path Destruction
Author: StultusVMods
Description:
Destroying paths and floors on your farm can be a huge nightmare, especially when you have hundreds upon hundreds to help compartmentalize everything. This mod gets around that issue by allowing you to toggle "Destruction Mode". When enabled, simply stand next to the tile of a path or floor that you wish to destroy, click on that tile, and the path or floor will be broken and leave behind its collectable item. There is an option in the config that lets you choose whether or not the player needs to be next to the tile to destroy it. It's a pretty small and niche mod, but I think it can be very helpful to those that don't care for the hours of mining floors around the farm.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[*]Enable Destruction Mode by pressing "B" (configurable). Check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Button_codes]this page on the wiki[/url]﻿ for acceptable button codes to use in the config

[*]Hold down "Left-Click" (configurable) while standing next to the chosen tile in order to break the path or floor that's on it.

[*]That's it! Enjoy spending your time on other stuff around the farm instead of breaking floors.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.
[/list]
